title: Yellowish Creamy Filipino Chicken Curry
description: A comforting and creamy Filipino chicken curry dish featuring green curry paste and a rich, cheesy sauce, perfect for a sick day or a weeknight dinner. It is a satvik-friendly and grassy dish with a cheese-pull effect.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the green curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pan and simmer the curry for 10 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
If using cheese, stir it in during the last 2 minutes of cooking to create a cheese-pull effect.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot over rice or noodles.
